reason: The six peak positions and approximate isolated-peak intensity ratios support an indexed reciprocal metric and extinction pattern, but exact structure recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory performed no whole-profile refinement or adequate comparison of physically plausible alternatives. Most decisively, the submitted one-site R-3m lattice has c = 1.63441 A and therefore a 1.63441 A Au-Au repeat/contact (V/Au about 13.24 A^3), which is grossly implausible for elemental Au; the trace calculated this minimum separation but did not reject the model. Thus the convenient symmetry realization, coordinates, and Z are not sufficiently supported, and a materially different physically credible structure could plausibly improve the candidate set.
